nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions should hit `graphify query/path/explain` first because they return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; `graphify update .` after code changes keeps the graph current at no API cost (AST-only).

nodes.label: graphify-out Knowledge Graph Store
nodes.rationale: Persistent graph directory (graph.json, wiki/index.md) with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships; wiki index preferred over raw source browsing for broad navigation.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Read only for broad architecture review or when query/path/explain do not surface enough context — it is the large fallback, not the default entry point.
